title: Croque Monsieur Burger
description: A French twist on the classic burger, featuring a crispy croatian-style patty and melted cheese.

ingredients.name: Croque burger patty (mix of burger and aerated)
ingredients.notes: Season with salt and pepper to taste

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Butter one side of each bun.
Cook the burger patty in the pan, approximately 4-5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the buns in the oven at 180°C for 5 minutes.
Assemble the burger by spreading mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, a few slices of ham, the cheese, and finally the burger patty.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the bun is crispy.
